core.title: MapReduce · NoSQL persistence · Data visualization
core.why: These three carry the project: MapReduce shows the distributed processing model on real records (word count, aggregates, joins, sorting, searching), MongoDB shows NoSQL persistence of schemaless run documents, and the visualization layer turns both into the decade x cluster dashboards.

experiments.title: MapReduce: matrix mult, aggregates, joins, sorting, searching

concepts.name: HDFS blocks, replication & rack awareness
concepts.summary: HDFS splits a file into fixed-size blocks, replicates each block 3× and places replicas rack-aware across DataNodes.
concepts.how: The corpus is modelled as one HDFS file against a 4-node / 2-rack cluster, with the block map, replica locations and DataNode occupancy computed from the real file size.

concepts.name: hdfs dfs / dfsadmin command surface
concepts.summary: mkdir, put, ls, count, du, cat, stat, fsck, setrep, balancer, expunge, report, safemode.
concepts.how: A 24-command transcript is rendered with the dataset's real byte counts, block ids, replica racks and fsck health output.

concepts.name: MapReduce word count
concepts.summary: map emits (word, 1); a combiner sums locally; the reducer produces final counts.
concepts.how: Track titles are tokenized (stopword-filtered) and counted by the in-process MapReduce runtime.

concepts.name: Map / shuffle / combine / reduce phases
concepts.summary: Every phase is separately timed and counted: map tasks, key partitioning, shuffle groups and reducers.
concepts.how: The runtime exposes partition_pair counts per reducer plus per-phase timings for five different jobs.

concepts.name: Combiners cutting shuffle traffic
concepts.summary: A combiner aggregates map output per map task so fewer pairs cross the network.
concepts.how: The aggregates job reports pairs before/after the combiner and the resulting percentage saved.

concepts.name: Map-side (broadcast) join
concepts.summary: Joining a large relation with a small one by broadcasting the small table to every map task.
concepts.how: Tracks are enriched with their cluster label (inner-join semantics) with no shuffle of the large side.

concepts.name: Sorting & top-N
concepts.summary: Count per key, then sort the reduced output and cut the top N.
concepts.how: Artist frequency across the corpus, sorted descending after the reduce phase.

concepts.name: Searching via an inverted index
concepts.summary: token → posting list, so a query is a lookup instead of a full scan.
concepts.how: Title tokens are mapped to track ids with a bounded posting cap, then a term is queried.

concepts.name: Bloom filter sized for a 1% false-positive rate
concepts.summary: A bit array plus k hash functions test membership in O(k) with no false negatives.
concepts.how: Artist names are indexed; m and k are derived from the item count with m = -n ln p / (ln 2)² and double hashing.

concepts.name: Bloom filter lab table (ASCII → hashes → bits)
concepts.summary: Insert words, set bits, then classify test words as True positive / False positive / Not present.
concepts.how: The manual's exercise is executed literally, including a 11-bit variant that saturates to show why sizing matters.

concepts.name: Distributed K-Means (MLlib semantics)
concepts.summary: K-Means with seed 42 over the scaled feature vectors, evaluated by silhouette and inertia/training cost.
concepts.how: Runs on PySpark MLlib when a compatible JVM/Python is present, otherwise the pandas/sklearn mirror.

concepts.name: PCA dimensionality reduction (8D → 2D)
concepts.summary: Principal component analysis projects the scaled feature space to two components for visualization.
concepts.how: The projection is plotted as an interactive scatter with points coloured by cluster.

concepts.name: VectorAssembler + StandardScaler
concepts.summary: Features are assembled into one vector and standardized so tempo/loudness ranges don't dominate distance.
concepts.how: numpy standardization with ddof=0 reproduces Spark's StandardScaler(withMean, withStd) exactly.

concepts.name: 70/30 train–test split
concepts.summary: randomSplit([0.7, 0.3], seed=42) — hold out test data before evaluating.
concepts.how: train_test_split(test_size=0.3, random_state=42) on the era-classification target.

concepts.name: Supervised classification: RF / DecisionTree / LogisticRegression
concepts.summary: Predict whether a track is modern (year ≥ 2000) from its acoustic features alone.
concepts.how: Three classifiers are trained and ranked on the held-out test set.

concepts.name: Accuracy, precision, recall, F1, ROC-AUC
concepts.summary: The metric set the manual lists for classification, plus the ROC curve.
concepts.how: Each model is scored on the 30% holdout and its ROC curve is plotted.

concepts.name: Confusion matrix
concepts.summary: TP/FP/FN/TN breakdown of the best classifier on the test split.
concepts.how: Rendered as a 2×2 grid on the results page.

concepts.name: Feature importance
concepts.summary: Random-Forest impurity importance quantifies which acoustic feature carries the era signal.
concepts.how: Importances are ranked and shown as a bar chart.

concepts.name: Hierarchical (Ward) clustering + dendrogram
concepts.summary: An alternative clustering family that builds a merge tree rather than requiring k up front.
concepts.how: Ward linkage on a sample produces real merge heights, drawn as a dendrogram, and ARI compares it with K-Means.

concepts.name: Elbow method + silhouette sweep
concepts.summary: Inertia (within-cluster SSE) and silhouette across k=2..10 to justify the chosen k.
concepts.how: Both curves are computed on a bounded sample and plotted side by side.

concepts.name: MongoDB document store (schemaless persistence)
concepts.summary: Runs are stored as nested documents with a JSON-file fallback when MongoDB is unreachable.
concepts.how: Live collection statistics, document schema paths and a sample document are reported per run.

concepts.name: NoSQL queries + aggregation pipeline
concepts.summary: CRUD surface, nested-field queries, $lt/$gt comparison, array-contains and $group aggregations.
concepts.how: 24 commands are documented; the read-only ones are executed live and their results shown.

concepts.name: Network construction from a similarity matrix
concepts.summary: A k-NN cosine graph over standardized acoustic vectors stands in for a social graph.
concepts.how: Nodes are sampled tracks; edges connect each track to its most acoustically similar neighbours.

concepts.name: Degree centrality + degree distribution
concepts.summary: Degree histogram, clustering coefficient, density, connected components and PageRank influence.
concepts.how: Node size/colour encodes degree; a histogram and a hub leaderboard are rendered.

concepts.name: Network layouts (force-directed + degree rings)
concepts.summary: Fruchterman-Reingold force layout and a degree-ordered concentric layout.
concepts.how: The layout is computed in the backend and rendered as an interactive SVG graph.

concepts.name: Community detection (label propagation)
concepts.summary: Communities are found by label propagation and scored with modularity.
concepts.how: Each community is cross-tabbed against the acoustic clusters to show agreement.

concepts.name: Tumbling + sliding windows over an event stream
concepts.summary: The static corpus is replayed as a stream of micro-batches with rolling aggregates.
concepts.how: Events are ordered by release year; window means and an EWMA are plotted.

concepts.name: Watermark & late-arriving events
concepts.summary: Event time vs arrival time, with late events counted against the running maximum.
concepts.how: Arrival order is the frame order; lateness is measured in release years.

concepts.name: Concept drift / change-point detection
concepts.summary: A z-score test against the previous rolling window flags distribution shifts.
concepts.how: The decade 'vibe shift' becomes an explicit list of detected change points.

concepts.name: Descriptive statistics + Pearson correlation
concepts.summary: Mean/std/quartiles/skew/kurtosis per feature and a full correlation matrix.
concepts.how: Rendered as a correlation heatmap with the strongest pairs called out.

concepts.name: Outlier & anomaly detection
concepts.summary: IQR fences per feature plus a multivariate Isolation Forest count.
concepts.how: Flag counts and percentages are shown per feature with the global anomaly rate.

concepts.name: Interactive data visualization
concepts.summary: Decade×cluster heatmap, cluster-profile heatmap, PCA scatter, trend lines, KD/elbow curves, dendrogram, graph view.
concepts.how: React + Recharts dashboards fed by the run results JSON.

concepts.name: Execution benchmarking: distributed vs single-node
concepts.summary: The same aggregation timed in PySpark and in pandas, plus a vectorized-vs-loop baseline.
concepts.how: Every run records the two timings and the speedup factor.
concepts.metric: Vectorized pandas (groupby engine) vs Pure-Python row loop → 12.84× speedup
